name: Ponk Chaat
instructions: 1. Gently rinse the fresh tender green jowar (ponk) and pat them dry if necessary.
2. In a large mixing bowl, combine the cleaned ponk with finely chopped onions, tomatoes, and green chili paste.
3. Add the roasted peanuts, chaat masala, black salt, and regular salt according to taste.
4. Drizzle fresh lemon juice over the mixture and toss everything thoroughly until well combined.
5. Transfer to a serving dish and garnish generously with fresh coriander and crispy sev before serving immediately to maintain the texture.
description: Ponk Chaat is a seasonal delicacy prepared during the harvest season of tender green sorghum (jowar). Popular in the coastal regions of Daman and Diu, this dish highlights the simplicity of farm-fresh ingredients. It is cherished for its fresh, earthy flavor profile and is often enjoyed as a light evening snack or a refreshing appetizer, reflecting the agricultural roots and vibrant street food culture of the region.
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
